paper_metadata.title: Ultra-high strength Inconel 718 alloy produced by a novel heat treatment
paper_metadata.journal: Transactions of Nonferrous Metals Society of China

evidence.quote: Inconel 718 alloy, one of the most common nickel-based superalloys, exhibits excellent mechanical properties even up to ~650 °C
The microstructures of cold-rolled sample. It was illustrated that equiaxed grains were replaced by elongated grains after cold rolling.
It is worth noting that the ultra-short annealed sample was almost fully recrystallized after double aging treatment
the 980-30min-aged sample maintained fully recrystallized structure after aging treatment
The as-received Inconel 718 alloy round bar was forged and hot-rolled into sheets with a thickness of 3 mm.
The as-received Inconel 718 alloy round bar was forged and hot-rolled into sheets with a thickness of 3 mm.
The hot-rolled sheet was firstly solution treated at 1050 °C for 35 min and then air cooled to room temperature.
Subsequently, the solution-treated sheet was subjected to cold rolling, and the thickness reduction was 60% (from 3 to 1.2 mm).
Then, the cold-rolled sheet was annealed at 980 °C for 1 min and 30 min, respectively.

both the cold-rolled and annealed samples underwent double aging treatment, including holding at 720 °C for 8 h, followed by furnace cooling to 620 °C at 50 °C/h and holding at 620 °C for 8 h, and then air quenching to room temperature.
Then, the cold-rolled sheet was annealed at 980 °C for 1 min and 30 min, respectively.

both the cold-rolled and annealed samples underwent double aging treatment, including holding at 720 °C for 8 h, followed by furnace cooling to 620 °C at 50 °C/h and holding at 620 °C for 8 h, and then air quenching to room temperature.
Equiaxed grains could be seen in the sample, and the average grain size was about 77.3 µm.
equiaxed grains were replaced by elongated grains after cold rolling
plenty of shear bands were formed during the cold deformation, and the orientation between the rolling direction and the shear bands was about 30°

many granular δ particles precipitated in the sample and most of them precipitated along the grain boundaries (indicated by red arrows). In contrast, very few δ phase existed in the sample annealed at 980 °C for 1 min

Many annealing twins could be observed in the sample (Fig. 5(c)), which also indicated that the sample previously annealed at 980 °C for 1 min underwent static recrystallization during the double aging treatment
the 980-1min-aged sample exhibited completely recrystallized microstructure. As estimated from EBSD data in Fig. 5(d), the recrystallization fraction was about 96.84%.
complete recrystallization occurred and the corresponding recrystallization fraction was about 93.69%
The cold-rolled (CR) sample exhibited the highest hardness of HV 461.
the 980-1min-aged sample had the highest hardness of HV 687
the hardness of HV 540 can be observed in the 980-30min-aged sample.
When the 980-1min-aged sample was subjected to room temperature deformation, the ultimate strength and total elongation were about 1598.32 MPa and 19.01%, respectively.

the value of elongation was increased slightly (~20.04%)
